messages:
maya: heads-up, saw a GPU flake on node gpu-12 in eu-west-1 — intermittent ECC warnings and occasional Xid 31, drainer kicked once.
alex.k: thanks, can you paste the nvlog and serial?
maya: pasted with small snippet:
```
[2026-03-15 09:21:12] ECC error detected: device 0
[2026-03-15 09:22:05] Xid 31 on GPU 0
kernel: GPU 00000000:01:00.0: GPU lost
```
Serial: SN-AB12-3C45D6
josh_s: tagged node, remoted in, running `nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY,ERROR` now.
ops-bot: auto-drain initiated for gpu-12 at 2026-03-15T09:25:00Z by policy gpu-flaky-async
linda_ops: created vendor ticket VEND-789342, ETA depot swap 5-7 business days. Adding serial.
maya: is there spare in region? we need capacity for batch jobs.
alex.k: there are 2 spares in eu-west-1 spare-pool-A, can hot-swap if courier available.
josh_s: note: this card has intermittent PCIe link flaps — vendor asked for full logs + kernel oops. Attached a brief of `dmesg | grep -i gpu` and `sar` snapshots.
rma-support: vendor portal updated: case VEND-789342 -> RMA#RM-112233, return label created. Depot swap scheduled 2026-03-20.
linda_ops: planning manual swap window 3/20 02:00-04:00 UTC, scheduler please hold non-critical jobs.
maya: ack. will reschedule big batches.
alex.k: verify serial handshake when depot swaps: we need `serial_check` script to reconcile against inventory. use `inv reconcile --serial SN-AB12-3C45D6`.
josh_s: ran reconcile, status: "pending_depot_inbound". I also increased monitoring threshold to alert on 3 Xid in 1h.
ops-bot: alert rule updated by josh_s: gpu-xid-burst -> 3 in 60m
maya: after swap, recommend burn-in test: 24h stress + ECC scan. create ticket for QA.
linda_ops: QA ticket created QA-5561, assigned to platform-hardware.
alex.k: thanks. anyone want to add anything before I close thread?
maya: pls include freight tracking once label scans at origin.
